17.43187,99.78625: Wat Nang Phaya Mr. Thien, the local villager had informed king Rama VI about a legendary of the temple that, it was constructed by princess Pasujadeve, the daughter of a King of China. However, there is no archaeological evidence supports the words. The temple contains a bell-shaped principal Chedi on an elevated platform. Located in front of the main Chedi was a main Vihara, which was decorated with beautiful stucco modeling. In the right direction of the temple, is a section containing the monk's living quarters, Ubosoth located at the back of the temple and two Chedis on the left side of the principal one.
